 ASTRAL PROJECTIONS
 Scorpio’s Revelations Are Going to Be Hard to Ignore
 Use them to go onward and upward
 By Robert Cromwell Oct 21, 2026 
 This week, the Sun enters Scorpio: the sign of transformation, purification, mystery, and passion.
 The Venus-ruled signs are potentially in for a brutal awakening, as this Scorpio season starts with a Venus retrograde cazimi on Oct. 23. For many, this will come with some personal revelations. Scorpio has no patience for illusion and will bring your attention to issues of trust, intimacy, and self-worth — and your hidden desires. All of that emotional baggage you’ve been carrying around is about to get unpacked.
 While this cazimi is brief, it will be very difficult to ignore the things that come to light during this time. Some of what’s revealed will be up close and personal, but some may be on the world stage.
 Think of it this way: while Scorpio’s stinger may hurt, you’ll be thankful later because it’s dispensing some much-needed medicine.
 ARIES
 March 21 – April 19
 Taking on responsibility starts to feel more like freedom than servitude when you’re actively deciding your goals. Notice that you’re not trapped in your life. You’re living it.   
 TAURUS
 April 20 – May 20
 A brief shining moment of clarity this week should help you understand exactly what has been holding you back — and what it will take to push forward. Sometimes you have to get lost to remember where you’re going.   
 GEMINI
 May 21 – June 20
 Your sharp tongue can get you in a lot of trouble depending on the company you keep. It can also open your eyes to who your real friends are as opposed to those who just benefit from their proximity to you.   
 CANCER
 June 21 – July 22
 It’s easy to forget yourself when you’re navigating everyone else’s needs and feelings. If that homecoming moment when you settle back into your own life feels chaotic, that’s a sign you’ve got your own things to settle.   
 LEO
 July 23 – Aug. 22
 This is prime time to be hitting the gym, metaphorically and maybe physically. Rapid personal improvement starts with a plan, but you have to stick with it to get the results you’re looking for. Keep it up!   
 VIRGO
 Aug. 23 – Sept. 22
 I trust your advice implicitly, Virgo, but it may not always land right. Most people aren’t hearing what you’re saying, just what they think you mean. Keep that in mind when you’re trying to solve someone else’s problems.
 LIBRA
 Sept. 23 – Oct. 22
 Sometimes you have to fight to come to a real understanding of things. The conflict’s not about you, really; it’s about what the other person needs to “get it.” If you can handle it, just play along.   
 SCORPIO
 Oct. 23 – Nov. 21
 There are a lot of realizations coming through as we enter your birthday season. Celebrate them; they will give you the opportunity to move onward and upward.
 SAGITTARIUS
 Nov. 22 – Dec. 21
 It’s easy to feel left behind as everyone around you goes through changes (or not). That loneliness is part of the cycle that will bring you closer to the people and places you want to be near.   
 CAPRICORN
 Dec. 22 – Jan. 19
 Slow progress isn’t no progress. It’s unwise to rush what is moving forward in a safe and stable way. Putting jet fuel in a car isn’t going to make it fly, regardless of what some people may want you to believe.   
 AQUARIUS
 Jan. 20 – Feb. 18
 The emotions that begin to arise as you meet the changes you’ve been planning should not be ignored, compartmentalized, or set aside for later. I don’t want to hear “there’s no time for mourning” from you. Feel your feelings, even if it’s only for a moment.   
 PISCES
 Feb. 19 – March 20
 Throwing yourself into unfamiliar waters can be disorienting, but there’s less time to be confused if you keep yourself active and busy. You can deal with all that mess later.
